verdict.rationale: Slate documents parallel orchestration: it spins up multiple background agents shown as a grid of subagent cards, and you can open each card to follow that agent's session. That framing is about splitting different tasks across agents, not running several attempts at the same task and picking a winner. missing for 10: explicit best-of-N or multiple attempts of the same task, side-by-side result/diff comparison, a mechanism to choose and apply one attempt, independent or hands-on corroboration.
